input.brief: The South Barbers, a Manila barbershop whose interactive lookbook helps a visitor choose a cut and demonstrate a complete appointment request

direction.name: Photographs at uneven sizes
direction.idea: A calm page where the pictures are placed like prints on a gallery wall: each at its own size and position, with text set small and light between them. Nothing lines up in the obvious way, yet everything sits on a grid you can feel. The unevenness is what makes it read as art-directed by a person: a small portrait far left, a wide landscape running off the right edge, a square that overlaps the next section. It lets photographs lead without ever becoming a slideshow.
direction.composition: A 12-column grid with wide margins (5–7vw). The hero is a single line of large light type (6–9vw) across the top third, and below it one photograph placed off-centre (columns 6–12, 16:10), its top edge overlapping the baseline zone of the headline by a few pixels of deliberate tension. Each following section places two or three photographs with different spans and vertical offsets: for example a 3:4 portrait in columns 2–5 starting 120px lower than a 16:10 landscape in columns 7–12; then a single small 1:1 in columns 9–11 beside a paragraph in columns 2–6. Paragraphs are short (max 40ch) and sit in the gaps. No two consecutive sections use the same arrangement. Vertical spacing is large and irregular on purpose (120–260px).
direction.typography: A light or regular weight at large size for the few headings; small, quiet text. Serif or a slender sans. Everything left-aligned to grid lines.
direction.colour: A pale neutral ground with one deep ink taken from the photographs. No accent beyond a quiet link colour.
direction.imagery: Six to nine photographs from one set, in a deliberate mix of ratios (3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 16:10, 21:9). Square corners. Captions, if any, are one short line under an image in the soft ink.
direction.richness: Placement. The differing sizes and offsets create movement on a still page.
direction.pitfalls: Uneven is not random: every image edge lands on a column line, and offsets come from a small set of values. On a phone, keep the unevenness with alternating widths (100%, 72% left, 60% right) rather than stacking everything full width.

hero.name: Stepped title, two photographs
hero.blueprint: A pale neutral ground with 6vw side margins on a 12-column grid. Navigation is three small items on the top edge at 15px: one link hard left, the wordmark centred, the single action hard right. The headline is two words or short phrases on two lines in a thin serif at clamp(72px, 8.3vw, 128px), leading 1.0, stepping diagonally across the middle third of the screen: the first line starts at column 2 with its baseline at 44% of the height; the second is indented to start at column 6 and ends near column 12. Two photographs are placed against the step, both with square corners. A small 16:10 landscape in columns 10-12 hangs from 10% of the height and stops about 20px above the first line. A 4:5 photograph in columns 2-5 starts 24px under the first line's baseline, to the left of the indented second line, and is cropped by the bottom edge of the viewport. Under the second line, starting on column 6, one sentence at 20px in the soft ink, max 36ch. Columns 6-12 of the lower third stay empty.
hero.mobile: The step survives: the first line at 15vw flush to the 20px left margin, the second line indented by 22vw. The small landscape sits above the title at 46% of the width, pushed to the right margin. The tall photograph follows the title at 72% of the width on the left margin, cropped by the bottom of the screen; the sentence at 16px moves beneath it.
hero.headline: Two words or short phrases, one per line, at most 9 characters each so the indented second line fits a phone.

type.note: A sturdy grotesque kept at regular weight even at 88px, so the page reads as composed rather than loud. Suits finance, infrastructure and research pages that need to look sober and current.

palette.name: Three stones
palette.note: Three close stone tones share the interface: the lightest for the page, the middle one for panels, the darkest for a single band, all with charcoal type. Saturated colour is left to the photographs and their backdrops; the grey-green fills the button only.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Frame run, one lifted
sections.blueprint: Columns 1–3 are a nearly empty column: the heading (two to four words at 24–28px) at the top, a link under it, and one or two short notes at 15px much further down, each level with the frame it describes. Columns 4–12 hold a run of six to eight frames of the same subject at one fixed height of 30vh, with natural widths and 6px gaps: the whole view, a tight crop of the same thing, a detail, the reverse side. The run is allowed to leave the right edge. One frame is lifted out of the row: shown at 2.2 times the row height with its bottom aligned to the row's bottom (flex row, align-items: end), so it stands above the others. Under each frame, at 15px: a name on the left and a single fact on the right. Square corners, no captions on the images.
sections.mobile: The heading and link sit on top. The lifted frame comes first at full width. The rest of the run scrolls sideways beneath it at a fixed height of 34vw with 4px gaps and scroll-snap, bleeding off the right edge. Notes are listed under the run at 15px.

sections.name: Prices like a menu
sections.blueprint: Prices set the way a good menu sets them. A heading of two to three words at 32–40px sits in columns 1–3. Columns 5–12 hold the list in two text columns with a 64px gap. Items are grouped under plain group names at 24px in medium weight with 48px above each group. Each item is a row: the name at 19px on the left, the price at the same size on the right on the same baseline, with tabular figures and the currency sign shown only once per group; beneath the name, one line of description at 16px in the softer ink, no wider than 36ch. Rows are 22px apart. Name and price are joined only by empty space (flex with `justify-content: space-between`), with no dot leaders and no lines. One small photograph (4:5, three columns wide) may sit under the heading in the left zone.
sections.mobile: One column. The heading at 28px, then the photograph at 60% width if used. Each item keeps name left and price right on one line at 17px, with its description beneath in the softer ink. Group names at 20px with 40px above.

sections.name: Pinned title, portraits pass
sections.blueprint: A wrapper tall enough for its portraits: about 90svh per person, up to six people. A `position: sticky; top: 0` layer of 100svh holds the heading, two words at clamp(88px, 12vw, 180px), leading 0.85, centred at mid-height, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` so it reads over ground and photographs alike. Beneath it in the stacking order, portraits scroll past in normal flow: each a 4:5 photograph 26–30vw wide, alternately starting at column 2 and ending at column 11, 60svh apart, so each one passes behind a different half of the heading. Under each portrait's left corner: the name at 18px, the role at 14px in the soft ink, and one sentence of up to 30 words in a 280px measure. The last portrait is followed by 40svh of empty ground before the heading releases. Square corners. Nothing else is on screen.
sections.mobile: The heading shrinks to 17vw and pins 16px from the top instead of at mid-height. Portraits become 72% wide, alternating between the left and right margins, 48px apart, each with name, role and sentence beneath at the portrait's width.

sections.name: One scene, stepping statements
sections.blueprint: A wrapper 350–450vh tall holds a sticky full-bleed photograph (100vw by 100svh) with a calm, symmetrical subject and a clear upper third; a neutral dark scrim covers only that upper third. At top centre, five or six short statements of two to five words are stacked at 18–20px with 10px between them; the first of them is the section's heading. One statement is at full white and the rest at 45% opacity; the active line steps down the stack as the reader scrolls (IntersectionObserver on invisible 70vh markers). For each statement, two small photographs with square corners, 160–240px wide and of different ratios, fade in left and right of the centre line at different heights, then leave when the next pair arrives. No other text. A low-key image on a deep ground works equally well.
sections.mobile: The photograph stays sticky at 100svh, cropped to its centre. The statement stack moves to the bottom third over a scrim, at 17px, left-aligned on the margin. Each statement brings one small photograph only, 44vw wide, placed in the top-right corner with a 16px margin.

sections.name: Portrait and offset quotation
sections.blueprint: A 12-column row on the page ground with wide margins. A portrait of the speaker, 3:4, fills columns 2–5 and is tall, about 70svh; it takes whatever mask the page gives its photographs (square corners, or the page's one motif shape). The quotation occupies columns 7–12 and starts 120px lower than the top of the portrait: four to six lines at clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light or regular weight, leading 1.2, measure about 26ch. The name and role sit 32px beneath the quotation at 16px, on its left edge. A second, small photograph (1:1, columns 10–11) hangs 96px below the attribution and shows the place or the thing the speaker is talking about. There is no heading. Nothing is centred; every edge lands on a column line, and the two vertical offsets are the design.
sections.mobile: The portrait runs at 72% width from the left margin, 3:4. The quotation follows at 24px, full width, starting 32px beneath. Name and role sit under it. The small second photograph sits at 44% width against the right margin, 48px lower, overlapping nothing.

sections.name: Sentence, portrait, two links
sections.blueprint: One closing row of three elements hanging from the same top line, with open ground between them, on a 12-column grid. Columns 1–5: a sentence of 12–18 words at clamp(26px, 3vw, 44px), four lines, leading 1.1, saying what kind of enquiries are welcome; it is set as a paragraph and there is no separate heading. Columns 8–9: one small square portrait or photograph of the place, 150–170px, with square corners. Columns 10–12: a short question at 18px in medium weight, then 20px below it two underlined links stacked at 18px (the email address and one booking or social link), and beneath them a line at 14px in the soft ink with the city and the usual reply time. Columns 6–7 stay empty. The row has 160px of space above and 120px below. No form. On a dark ground the photograph is the only bright thing in the row.
sections.mobile: The sentence comes first at 7.4vw. Below it the portrait at 96px square sits at the left margin with the question and the two links to its right, top-aligned, in the remaining width. The city and reply-time line spans the full width beneath.

sections.name: A plain sentence, one action
sections.blueprint: The page ends on an almost empty screen. On the page ground, with no band and no panel, one sentence of eight to fourteen words is set at 18–22px in the regular weight, in the full ink, no wider than 34ch, on the same left edge as the page's text column (or centred only if the whole page is centred). 24px beneath it sits one small filled button, about 40px tall with 18px side padding, and optionally one text link beside it on the same baseline. That is all. Above the sentence leave at least 30svh of empty ground and below it at least 20svh before the footer line, so the emptiness reads as decided. The sentence is written as something a person would say, and it names the action plainly. No headline-sized type appears anywhere in this section.
sections.mobile: Identical in spirit: the sentence at 18px with 20px margins, the button beneath at its natural width (not full width), 44px tall. Keep 20svh of empty ground above the sentence and 14svh below the button, before the footer line.

sections.name: Name first, places under it
sections.blueprint: The wordmark opens the footer instead of closing it. On a full-bleed field in the page's inverse or final chapter colour, the name spans the full content width as the first thing, its cap line pushed 8% above the footer's top edge so the tops of the letters are sliced off by the section (`overflow: hidden` and a negative top margin in `em`). 72px beneath, a two-part row: columns 1–5 list the places or ways to reach the studio (cities, or email and telephone), one per line at 32–36px in the accent ink, each a link; columns 7–12 hold three columns of small links at 15px, top-aligned with the first place. A final row 96px lower carries the legal line at the left and a back-to-top text link at the right, both 13px. The field is about 90svh tall, and nothing sits between the wordmark and the row but space.
sections.mobile: The sliced wordmark stays at the top, fitted to the width. Places follow as a list at 26px, then the link columns two across at 15px. Legal line and back-to-top link share the last row at 12px, at opposite margins.

references.name: Sobha Privy Collection
references.idea: Luxury homes sold by restraint: a black sculptural render and a script-over-capitals title, then white pages where interior images grow and overlap huge serif capitals as you scroll.
references.hero: Full-bleed near-black video of a glossy black sculptural form, wide curved bands catching thin highlights, filling the frame at very low contrast. A centred two-line title about 46% of the width: a formal script phrase at about 6.9vw, then a line of light roman serif capitals at about 6vw directly beneath, wider than the script. Nothing else in the middle. Corners only: a two-line hamburger with a menu label top-left, a small serif wordmark with a micro subtitle top-centre, a text link top-right, a circled down-arrow bottom-left, and bottom-right a greyscale 3D-map thumbnail about 17% wide with a numeral and a two-line label.
references.type: TT Ramillas in light uppercase for display (up to 7.9vw) paired with the formal script Altesse for two- or three-word accent phrases that overlap the capitals; TT Commons Pro at 13px for nav, eyebrows and body. A very large jump from 100px display to 13px text.
references.colour: #010101 #ffffff #d8cdbd #8a7862 #1a1919 — Black hero, then pure white pages with near-black type. Warmth comes only from the beige, cream and bronze interiors in the renders. No accent colour anywhere.
references.imagery: Architectural interior renders in cream and bronze (double-height dining halls, lounges, marble pool rooms) in tall portrait and near-square crops, square corners, arranged in groups of different sizes that scale with scroll. The hero is an abstract black sculptural render.
references.layout: Centred, symmetrical compositions (heading over a three-image group) alternate with asymmetric ones (large left-aligned capitals with images offset right and lower-left). A very long scroll-driven page of about 48 screens, with pinned image scaling between text moments.

sections.description: White section, centred. A two-line micro eyebrow in tracked capitals, then a two-line heading in light serif capitals at about 2.6vw. Below it a triptych: a tall centre image about 23vw wide at 3:4, flanked by two shorter images set lower, their tops about 30% down the centre image and their outer edges touching the viewport sides. On scroll the centre image scales up and the side images rise toward its top.

Pinned scaling group: the same three renders rearranged so the centre image is about 26vw wide and roughly 30% taller than its neighbours, which hang from a common line a little below its top and are cropped by the left and right viewport edges. Gaps are under 1vw. The fixed header stays above, its logo sitting on top of the image.

Statement with overlap: five lines of light serif capitals at about 5.5vw, flush left on a 1% margin, filling the left 55%. A grey script phrase overlaps the end of the last line and runs into a tall image occupying the right 25% from mid-height to the bottom. A second, small image about 12vw wide sits lower left under the text. Mid-transition frames show the capitals rising letter by letter from behind a baseline mask.

steal: Pair one short phrase in formal script with a line of light serif capitals beneath it, letting the script overlap the capitals or run into an adjacent image.
Arrange three images as a tall centre flanked by two lower ones cropped by the viewport edges, then scale the centre up on scroll.
Keep the hero to a near-black, low-contrast render with all controls pushed to the four corners so the centred title is the only bright thing.
references.media: A WebGL black ribbon covers the whole first screen behind the centred slogan, with a 240x140 map clip docked bottom-right (about 2.6%). Later: a centre portrait that grows from about 620 to 760px wide as it rises, a triptych with the flanking pictures cropped by the viewport edges, a picture sliding under the last lines of a statement, full-bleed night-skyline video interludes, a curved WebGL carousel pinned under a title and long pinned horizontal galleries; 28 images and 9 muted loops, square corners.
references.motion: After a preloader of about 1s the title drifts up a few pixels and settles by 2.5s, and Locomotive smooth scroll then scrubs nearly everything by transform as a continuous lerp: pictures move faster than text, each section slides over the previous one, and the three-worlds chapter pins a curved carousel and horizontal tracks for about 23,000px. 187 spans rise over 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.29,0.52,0.5,1) and 114 fade over 1s cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1), the stylesheet's main curve (32 uses).

references.name: Tengile Malamala Collection
references.idea: Let the land and animals carry everything: one staggered hairline-serif headline over aerial footage, then cream pages of olive-green serif text with photographs placed at uneven sizes.
references.hero: Aerial river footage fills the viewport, slightly darkened. Three small white caps items sit on the top edge: an enquiry link hard left, a stacked three-line wordmark centred, 'menu' hard right. The headline is two words on two lines in thin serif capitals about 8.3vw tall: the first line starts 10% from the left, the second is indented to 40% and ends near 90%, so the pair steps diagonally across the middle third. Below, starting at the 50% line, a three-line serif sentence at about 20px and a small white square-cornered button with a separate arrow square beside it. The lower third is left to the water.
references.type: PP Fragment at hairline weight (220): capitals for the 120px headline, sentence case for 28-36px olive statements. Inter at 11-16px for labels, nav and small paragraphs. Three serif sizes, two sans sizes; the serif never goes bold.
references.colour: #f5eee9 #5c6e21 #181608 #e3e1d4 #ffffff — Warm cream page with every word, large or small, in one olive green; the footer inverts to a solid olive field with cream text. Photography supplies all other colour.
references.imagery: Wildlife and lodge photography, natural and saturated, square corners, no overlays. Mixed aspect ratios placed at different widths and vertical offsets; lodge listings use equal landscape triplets; hero and closing band are full-bleed aerials.
references.layout: Narrow 16px outer margins and a twelve-column grid used asymmetrically: label and small paragraph in the left columns, the large statement starting at the midpoint. Sections alternate between loosely scattered image pairs and tidy three-up rows.

sections.description: Cream field. A tiny sans caps label top-left. A 28px olive serif paragraph of eight lines occupies only the right half, starting at the midpoint. Far below on the left, a five-line 12px sans paragraph about 180px wide. Images are placed loose: a landscape elephant photo under the right text, a tall leopard portrait lower at the left margin, a wide crop of elephant legs upper right of the next screen. No two share a top edge or width.

A tiny caps label, then an olive serif statement at about 36px running the full width for four lines. Beneath: a sub-label, a 12px paragraph held to a third of the width, then three equal landscape photos with 8px gutters spanning margin to margin, each captioned below in small serif. The same block repeats for a second category; one tile is dimmed with a short caps line laid over it to mark it as not yet open.

A full-bleed aerial of an elephant crossing a sandbank with a short serif statement, a small sans paragraph and the white button-plus-arrow pair set in the right half only. It butts directly against a solid olive footer: five columns of small cream links under tiny caps headings in the top third, a large empty green area beneath, and a legal line along the bottom edge.

steal: Stagger a two-line headline: first line from the left margin, second indented by 30% so the pair steps diagonally across the image.
Set every piece of text in a single brand colour on cream and make the footer that same colour as a solid field.
Split the button into two adjacent squares, label and arrow, with a 4px gap, small and square-cornered, instead of one pill.
references.media: A 10s muted aerial montage covers the whole first screen with type set on it and no visible scrim. Below: a split with an image and paragraph in the right half from the centre line, staggered image pairs with uneven heights and offsets, a three-up card row with captions, an inset full-width slider, a constellation of thumbnails round a centred heading, a slow portrait marquee, and a sticky full-bleed landscape with the closing call scrolling over it; 33 images, pictures oversized about 110% in their masks for drift.
references.motion: There is no preloader and only the montage cuts after 400ms, but under Lenis content stays hidden until each reveal fires: blocks rise and sharpen from a blur over 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), others fade with a filter over 1s cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1), pictures drift inside their masks, and the closing landscape holds on a sticky root. The ground steps from cream to sage-beige to olive, and the marquee loops on 120s.

references.name: Kereliott
references.idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
references.hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
references.type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
references.colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
references.imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
references.layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.
